ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Translation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Say Translation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Translation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Translation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Translation of the Qur’an.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq .

4. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Use Ulum al- Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith.
   C. Say Ulum al- Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Founders of Schools of jurisprudence has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Founders of Schools of jurisprudence.
   D. Use Founders of Schools of jurisprudence to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

7. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Finance? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Finance.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Islamic Finance has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Islamic Finance to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

10. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.
   D. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan.
   B. Use Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf.
   C. Say The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Ulum al- Hadith and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Hadith and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Apply the teaching of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. B — Apply the teaching of Translation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Apply the teaching of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. D — Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. B — Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

10. A — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. D — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Ulum al- Hadith; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Selected Hadith; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
